name: Twr y Felin Hotel
accommodation: 39 bedrooms and suites, including tower and oriel rooms
suitableFor: Couples and travellers wanting a hotel stay with dining and spa
beachAccess: Not stated; the hotel is in St Davids, a short walk from the Pembrokeshire Coast Path
confirmedFeatures: Blas restaurant, Awen Spa, art gallery with over 250 works, sculpture garden, event spaces
overview: Twr y Felin is a 39-bedroom hotel in St Davids built around a former windmill, with an art collection, spa and the Blas restaurant. It sits on the edge of the city a short walk from the coast path, with Whitesands a short drive west.
surfTripFit: It suits surfers who want a comfortable hotel and a proper dinner after a session at Whitesands, with the beach a short drive from the door.
